facts.text: Melanie took the kids to the museum, where they were excited about the dinosaur exhibit.

evidence.quote: They were stoked for the dinosaur exhibit! They love learning about animals and the bones were so cool.
Yesterday I took the kids to the museum - it was so cool spending time with them and seeing their eyes light up!

facts.text: Caroline is creating a library for when she has children, which includes books and toys.

evidence.quote: I'm creating a library for when I have kids. I'm really looking forward to reading to them and opening up their minds.
I've got lots of kids' books- classics, stories from different cultures, educational books, all of that.

facts.text: Melanie recalls that 'Charlotte's Web' was a favorite childhood book, highlighting themes of friendship and compassion.

evidence.quote: I loved reading 'Charlotte's Web' as a kid. It was so cool seeing how friendship and compassion can make a difference.
